title: Test projection repair naming unprojectable restored evidence
outcome: Test projection repair naming unprojectable restored evidence
acceptance: A test restores a completed item with restored gate evidence, damages the evidence (bytes that do not decode, a missing item, a broken constraint), and shows doctor --repair-projections naming each as work_restored_evidence:ID:<finding> with no missing_projection echo, then rolling back

completion.summary: A new test damages restored evidence on a restored completion (missing item, undecodable bytes, a broken sequence constraint). It shows projection repair naming each as work_restored_evidence:ID:<finding> with no missing_projection echo, then rolling back, and becoming healthy once the bytes are restored. Landed as 3d52ed6.
